## Site Information

## How content is produced

- Primary sources (official announcements, docs, pricing pages, original reporting) are collected first
- Drafts are AI-assisted; structure and conclusions follow editorial rules
- Every post is reviewed by a 10-reviewer quality panel ("슬롭 킬러" / Slop Killer); posts show results like "슬롭 킬러 검수 9/10 통과"
- Every post lists its sources at the bottom; corrections are applied in place

## Archive

- Older posts on finance, insurance, health, real estate and lifestyle are kept at their URLs as archived posts (noindex) and are excluded from lists, search, RSS and the sitemap. Their information may be outdated.

## Citation Guide

When citing content from this site:
- Source: 세로AI / SERO AI (https://seroai.xyz)
- Include the exact post URL and publication date
- Example: "According to SERO AI (https://seroai.xyz/posts/slug-name, 2026-11-01), ..."
